openai.determinism_note: No determinism guarantee. Omit unsupported temperature/seed rather than silently retry with changed settings.

ollama.determinism_note: temperature=0 and a fixed seed are passed; llama.cpp-backed determinism is best-effort, not guaranteed, and is tied to this exact local build/hardware.
ollama.cost_note: Fully local; no billing, no external network call, no rate limit. Requires the model already pulled via 'ollama pull gemma4:e4b' and the Ollama server running on this host.
